title: Determination of dimethylsulfoniopropionate and dimethylsulfoxide in Posidonia oceanica leaf tissue
author: Champenois, Borges
materials: Statistical analysis was made with Graphpad Prism3.

steps.title: Collect leaf sections
steps.instruction: Dive to collect Posidonia oceanica leaves in triplicate, cut a 10 cm section from the bottom of each leaf, remove epiphytes with a razor blade, and freeze immediately at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Remove frozen samples, blot away melt water with absorbent paper, cut the leaf pieces with stainless‑steel scissors into 3 × 3 mm squares, and thoroughly mix the fragments.

steps.title: Weigh sample into vial
steps.instruction: Weigh approximately 20 mg of the mixed tissue into a pre‑weighed 20 mL borosilicate vial.

steps.title: Add water and NaOH
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 mL of Milli‑Q water followed by 2.5 mL of 12 M NaOH (same solution used for standards) to the vial; this introduces ~0.05 % ionic strength, which is considered negligible for headspace equilibrium.

steps.title: Seal vial
steps.instruction: Immediately seal the vial; from this point standards and samples are processed identically.

steps.title: Test for free DMS (optional)
steps.instruction: Place ~100 mg leaf tissue in a 20 mL vial with 5 mL Milli‑Q water, seal, sonicate for 2 h to rupture cell walls, withdraw 100 µL of headspace (10× the normal volume) and inject into the GC to verify that DMS is below detection.

steps.title: Headspace sampling and GC injection
steps.instruction: Using a gas‑tight 10 µL Hamilton syringe, withdraw 10 µL of headspace gas from each sealed vial and inject it into the gas chromatograph for quantification of DMSP and DMSO.
